name: Wild Hunter
gmNotes: Wild Hunter is a military and law-enforcement patrol role, not a biological species. Wild Hunters patrol, search, pursue, and intimidate from animal-like hovering mounts whose machinery is often concealed at a distance. Record the role explicitly on applicable Fey characters. The Archetype grants no automatic mechanics.
description: A rider of the Wild Hunt, glimpsed between the trees on a dark and unnatural mount. Wild Hunters patrol lonely country, pursue those marked for capture, and bring the authority of the Fair Folk into places where no road should lead.
